facts.fact: WHO states that the health ministry developed a national strategic plan for the health and social information system (PSNSISS) 2022-2026, which covers building health actors' capacity to configure and use DHIS2, in place since 2013; the passage is undated, so the document's published year, 2024, is used.

WHO presents DHIS2, in place since 2013, as the software of the national health and social information system that the Ministère de la Santé et de l'Action sociale plans for and strengthens under its own strategic plan; undated, so the document's published year, 2024, is used.

WHO states that the health ministry, with the ministry in charge of digital affairs, carried out in 2021 a feasibility study of the health system digitalisation programme centred on six projects, the shared patient record first among them, following a digital health strategic plan 2018-2023; the document describes a study and a programme, not a costed plan.
